title: Mandaue City earmarks P85M for pothole-hit roads near CDU, Adnama

blocks.text: MANDAUE CITY, Cebu – The Mandaue City government has proposed P85 million for road and drainage projects along Potenciano Larrazabal Road near Cebu Doctors’ University (CDU) and Adnama under its 2027 budget plan to address persistent potholes in the area. City Administrator Atty. Gonzalo Malig-on Jr. said the proposed projects are included in the city’s 2027 Annual Investment Program (AIP) under the 20% Development Fund. The proposed allocation includes P40 million for drainage construction in PUD 1 fronting CDU and another P45 million for road and drainage construction in PUD 1 near Adnama.
